newsitem.title: UK: Guinness Flight Hambro names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Guinness Flight Hambro names chairman.

text.p: Guinness Flight Hambro Asset Management said Wednesday it had appointed Tom Griffin non-executive chairman.
Griffin was co-founder and chairman of investment managers GT Management.

"We are delighted Tom Griffin has agreed to become our chairman. Guinness Flight Hambro today looks forward to the guidance he will be able to give us in our endeavours as we strive to build a winning independent global investment management business," Guinness Flight Hambro chief executive Tim Guinness said.
Guinness Flight Hambro, with $15.9 billion under management, was created in May through the merger of Guinness Flight Global Asset Management and Hambros Fund Management.
